protocol.interference: Before a process wait for observed rustc/clang/clippy-driver to finish. If any boundary of the complete six-round three-arm cohort has a compiler, retain the whole cohort as diagnostic, wait six quiet seconds, repeat complete cohort at most four attempts. Never repeat based on timing results. Other host activity retained in boundary snapshots, no post-hoc exclusion.
protocol.timing: Starts immediately before call/submission; ends at synchronous result or Promise.all completion. Includes natural GC. Input loading/flattening, explicit pre-round GC and full-tree validation excluded.
protocol.resources: CPU and RSS cover whole process including input, warmup, validation and explicit GC; not API-phase CPU or allocation.
protocol.reporting: All cells reported, including slowdowns. No adoption gate or changes to implementation in this report.
